query:
Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
# This is the main CI workflow that runs the test suite on all pushes to main and all pull requests.
# It runs the following jobs:
# - required: runs the test suite on ubuntu with the specified rust toolchains
# - direct-minimal: runs the test suite with the minimal versions of the dependencies that satisfy the
#   requirements of this crate
# - os-check: runs the test suite on mac and windows
# See check.yml for information about how the concurrency cancellation and workflow triggering works
permissions:
  contents: read
on:
  push:
    branches: [master, main]
  pull_request:
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
name: test
jobs:
  vars:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    # https://rust-lang.github.io/rustup-components-history/
    outputs:
      nightly: nightly-2025-10-21
    steps:
      - run: echo "dummy job"
  required:
    needs: vars
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    name: ubuntu / ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        toolchain: ["${{ needs.vars.outputs.nightly }}"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true
      - uses: ./.github/actions/install-sdl2
      - name: Install ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
      - name: cargo generate-lockfile
        # enable this ci template to run regardless of whether the lockfile is checked in or not
        if: hashFiles('Cargo.lock') == ''
        run: cargo generate-lockfile
      # https://twitter.com/jonhoo/status/1571290371124260865
      - name: cargo test --locked
        run: cargo test --locked --all-features --all-targets
        env:
          PROPTEST_RNG_SEED: 0
      # https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/issues/6669
      - name: cargo test --doc
        run: cargo test --locked --all-features --doc
        env:
          PROPTEST_RNG_SEED: 0
  direct-minimal:
    needs: vars
    strategy:
      matrix:
        toolchain: ["${{ needs.vars.outputs.nightly }}"]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    name: ubuntu / ${{ matrix.toolchain }} / direct-minimal-versions
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true
      - uses: ./.github/actions/install-sdl2
      - name: Install ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
      - name: cargo update -Zdirect-minimal-versions
        run: cargo update -Zdirect-minimal-versions
      - name: cargo test
        run: cargo test --locked --all-features --all-targets
        env:
          PROPTEST_RNG_SEED: 0
  os-check:
    # run cargo test on mac and windows
    needs: vars
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    name: ${{ matrix.os }} / ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [macos-15, windows-2025]
        toolchain: ["${{ needs.vars.outputs.nightly }}"]
    steps:
      # if your project needs OpenSSL, uncomment this to fix Windows builds.
      # it's commented out by default as the install command takes 5-10m.
      # - run: echo "VCPKG_ROOT=$env:VCPKG_INSTALLATION_ROOT" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Append
      #   if: runner.os == 'Windows'
      # - run: vcpkg install openssl:x64-windows-static-md
      #   if: runner.os == 'Windows'
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true
      - uses: ./.github/actions/instal

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
